Exact threshold probabilities for a single-arm Bayes factor

pbinbf01_singlearm_exact.Rd

Calculates the probability that the Bayes factor BF01 falls strictly below a specified threshold, or the complementary probability that it is greater than or equal to that threshold. Probabilities are evaluated by summing over all possible binomial response counts.

Usage

pbinbf01_singlearm_exact(
  k,
  n,
  p0,
  a0 = 1,
  b0 = 1,
  a1 = 1,
  b1 = 1,
  dp = NA_real_,
  da0 = 1,
  db0 = 1,
  da1 = 1,
  db1 = 1,
  type = c("point", "direction"),
  lower.tail = TRUE
)

Arguments

k

Positive finite threshold on BF01, the Bayes factor comparing H0 with H1. To calculate the probability of BF10 > K, supply k = 1 / K and lower.tail = TRUE.

n

Number of patients or binomial trials; a nonnegative integer.

p0

Null response probability for type = "point", or the boundary between the null and alternative parameter regions for type = "direction". For directional hypotheses, must lie strictly between zero and one.

a0, b0

Positive beta shape parameters for the analysis prior under H0 when type = "direction". The prior is truncated and normalized on \([0,p_0]\). These parameters are not used for the point-null hypothesis.

a1, b1

Positive beta shape parameters for the analysis prior under H1. The prior is supported on \([0,1]\) for type = "point" and truncated and normalized on \((p_0,1]\) for type = "direction".

dp

Fixed response probability at which to evaluate the threshold probability. If NA_real_, probabilities are averaged over the H1 design prior specified by da1 and db1. Otherwise, binomial probabilities at dp are used.

da0, db0

Retained for interface compatibility. These arguments are not used by this function, which evaluates either a fixed-probability distribution or the H1 design-prior predictive distribution.

da1, db1

Positive beta shape parameters for the H1 design prior used when dp = NA_real_. This prior is supported on \([0,1]\) for type = "point" and truncated and normalized on \((p_0,1]\) for type = "direction". Ignored when dp is supplied.

type

Character string specifying the hypotheses. "point" compares the point null \(p=p_0\) with an alternative having a beta prior on \([0,1]\). "direction" compares \(p \le p_0\) with \(p > p_0\).

lower.tail

Logical. If TRUE, return \(P(BF_{01}<k)\). If FALSE, return the complementary probability \(P(BF_{01}\ge k)\).

Value

A numeric scalar giving the requested threshold probability.

Details

Analysis priors determine the Bayes factor at each response count. The fixed response probability dp, or the H1 design prior when dp is missing, determines the probabilities assigned to those counts.

The lower-tail inequality is strict, unlike the usual inclusive cumulative distribution convention. Equality is included in the complementary upper tail. Thus, lower.tail = FALSE does not calculate \(P(BF_{01}>k)\).

Comparisons are applied directly to the computed floating-point Bayes factors without an explicit numerical tolerance.
